Economist Jean Drèze detained during Delhi protest, released

Economist Jean Drèze was detained by Delhi Police during a protest at Jantar Mantar on October 10, 2026. He was later released. Reports indicate he was seen at the protest wearing simple clothes and carrying a bag. One outlet noted that he stayed until others less fortunate were also released.
